svg.text: You are accessing a Developer Information System (IS) that is provided for developer use only.

text.tspan: By using this IS (which includes any device attached to this IS), you consent to the following conditions:
• While the use of this system is probably secure, no warranty is expressed or implied.
• This system is powered by the tears of broken code and the joy of successful commits.
• A banana is a perfectly useful tool to demonstrate scale.
• Please refrain from using this system for schemes involving world domination.
That's reserved for our annual strategy meeting.
• If you encounter dragons, unicorns, or mythical bugs in this system, please
report them to our fantasy department.
• Users attempting to use this system for time travel purposes should note that
we do not support paradox resolution or alternate timelines.

svg.text: By logging in, you confirm you have read & consent to terms in IS user agreement.
